subject: Risk & Compliance
title: Bernie Madoff's $65 Billion Ponzi
description: A quick win: understand Bernie Madoff's $65 Billion Ponzi.

hook.text: Bernie Madoff ran the largest Ponzi scheme in history. For 17 years, nobody caught him.

buildup.text: Madoff promised steady 10-12% returns. He paid old investors with new investors' money. No actual trading occurred.

discovery.text: Harry Markopolos warned the SEC repeatedly starting in 1999. The SEC investigated and found nothing wrong.

twist.text: Madoff's scheme collapsed in 2008 only because the financial crisis triggered mass withdrawals he couldn't cover.

climax.text: Madoff destroyed $65 billion. Charities, pensions, and life savings vanished. He got 150 years in prison.

punchline.text: $65 billion. 17 years. The SEC ignored the warnings.

quiz.question: Why did Madoff's scheme finally collapse?
options: The 2008 crisis caused withdrawals he couldn't cover
The SEC caught him through an audit
